command: set -e; SERIAL=RFCT70L7E8J; adb -s "$SERIAL" get-state | grep -qx device; STATE=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys telephony.registry | sed -n 's/.*mCallState=\([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p' | head -n1 | tr -d '\r'); echo call_state=$STATE; test "$STATE" = "0"; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell ps -A -o USER,PID,NAME | grep -E '^shell[[:space:]]+[0-9]+[[:space:]]+shizuku_server$'; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys package pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge | grep -q 'moe.shizuku.manager.permission.API_V23: granted=true'; adb -s "$SERIAL" install -r app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk >/dev/null; echo milestone_d_app_death_preflight_ok=true
